'''2003 Illinois State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Illinois (31 May 2003).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS4]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Illinois
* '''Dates:''' 31 May 2003<ref name="pc-us03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 June 2004.</ref>
* '''Venue:''' Shorewood Public Library, Shorewood, Illinois<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Ronald Fonck|Ron Fonck]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Day 2 qualifier:''' [[Steve Kuperman]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
